node.title: Re: Removing unwanted characters and extra spaces from string.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The {2,} on \s won't work inside a []. Try this instead: [https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=g®ex=(%3F%3A%5B%5Ea-zA-Z0-9%2C_%5Cs%5D%2B%7C%5B%5Cs_%5D%5CK%5Cs%2B)&samp1=%E2%80%9CThe%20%20%20Class%20Description_%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20Test%E2%80%9D|s/(?:[^a-zA-Z0-9,_\s]+|[\s_]\K\s+)//g] (Note: The link needs a fairly modern browser to work.)

Update: I should mention that this regex also removes the space between Description_ and Test because that's what you showed in your expected output, but [hippo] is right to [id://1223160|ask] whether this is what you want. As always with regexes, please provide as many example inputs and outputs as possible, along with a clear spec!
